protocol.candidate: Break hot runs at nonpositive, invalid, or >2x within-workbook median positive timestamp intervals; no parameter tuning.
protocol.scope: Training workbooks only, paired fixed-candidate comparison.
protocol.quarters: Four consecutive equal-row portions; workbook labels do not guarantee fault visibility throughout each portion.
protocol.weighting: Average scenario scores within each workbook, then equally across workbooks.
protocol.adoption_gate: No full-workbook rank regression; strictly higher quarter rank-decay; no lower case-balanced score in other-cabin removal, target removal, pressure removal, or feature ablation. Faulty-cabin removal is informational only.

decision.reason: No improvement in any tested faulty-car rank or scenario-family score; full-workbook and quarter scores tie.

limitations: Six workbooks informed original feature development; these are robustness checks, not independent generalization estimates.
The 24 portions and synthetic missing-signal cases do not create new independent labelled cases.
Only one rich-pressure case is available.
Whole-workbook labels do not establish when a fault is detectable.
Removing the faulty cabin sensor destroys temperature evidence; fallback ordering is not a supported diagnosis.
